description: Opus BB unit B24: Utility Umbrella's `onUpdate` after a failed Trick. Setup: Weavile Tricks the umbrella away from Castform in Pelipper's rain (Castform-Rainy) and back (Castform keeps Castform-Rainy while holding it). Then Kangaskhan, holding its own Kangaskhanite, Tricks Castform: `target.takeItem()` succeeds and runs the umbrella's End (WeatherChange: Castform still sees rain, `effectState.inactive = true`), Kangaskhan's `takeItem()` fails, both items go back silently (`target.item = yourItem.id`, same item state) and the move fails. At the next Update the umbrella's `onUpdate` finds `inactive`, runs WeatherChange again with the umbrella held: Castform goes back to its base forme.
